summary: The history arrives a page at a time, newest first, with has_more and the cursor of the next page; never the whole of it.

then.note: At most `limit` events (20 by default, 50 at most), each {id, time, actor, kind, changes}; the oldest event's revision is the cursor «Показать ещё» sends back. A host with more than a page answers has_more true; a page of every event is not an answer.
